description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Archmage of Runes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat any number of times.
Resolve triggers from Archmage of Runes until you have drawn as many cards as desired.
If the remaining number of Archmage of Runes triggers is greater than the number of cards in your library, you must win the game or remove those triggers from the stack at instant speed to avoid losing from drawing from an empty library.
